hypothesis: W-R48 demonstrated one frozen W-R46 model can generalize across prospective synthetic cohorts while two models trained on different development cohorts fail. A fixed no-intercept 16-weight lag2 paired perceptron may be unstable under changes to training order alone. Prospectively train three models on EXACT identical fresh development examples, budget, learning rate and architecture, varying only example presentation order, then test all three on one fresh sealed 48-seed cohort.
freeze: New dev seeds2864..2879, sealed heldout2880..2927, three generator families/two swap sites/nine entities/identity and XOR55, balanced both-order evaluation. Development examples exactly source W-R43 1728 signed paired comparisons from affine_prior seed2864..2879. Three orders: original, full reverse, once-and-for-all Fisher-Yates shuffle random.Random(49049), reused identically across 32 epochs. No sample relabeling, class padding, or post-hoc reselection. Seed-level bootstrap 4096 with RNG49050 and per-family accuracy; original training budget held equal.
classification: TRAIN_ORDER_STABLE iff all three models have accuracy >=0.55, their maximum-minus-minimum accuracy<=0.05, and 2/3 heldout source generators >0.52 for each model. PARTIAL_ORDER_STABILITY iff at least two arms score >=0.55 and spread<=0.10. OTHERWISE_UNSTABLE otherwise. Preserve all per-seed/contrast/family adverse outcomes and update counts.
controls: The exact same development examples, labels, seed identities and total 1728 sample count occur once per epoch in every arm; only order varies and parameters share zero initialization, no bias, 16 weights, 32 epochs, LR0.1.

No heldout fitting or label use in model construction. All comparator presentations are both orientations with half-credit ties. Affine-only development is disclosed; generalization to other sources is explicitly tested, not assumed.
Training-update counts and final weight-vector SHA256 for all models archived. Identity and XOR55 exact feature invariance checked; cluster seed/bootstrap used for uncertainty, not model selection.
One sealed first-use original artifact followed by full Go test/build, no accepted-ref mutation or production/orchestrator change.
claim_limit: Synthetic two-choice training-order sensitivity under fixed data and compute budgets; no autonomous learning/general cognition claim.
